-> Merubah Dataset Menjadi Time Series
```{r}
Y <- ts(data_energy_bvar[, -1],
        start = 2002,
        frequency = 1)
```

-> Pemodelan BVAR

```{r}
library(BVAR)
set.seed(123)
model_bvar <- bvar(Y, lags = 3, n_draw = 3000, n_burn = 1500, verbose = TRUE)
```

```{r}
summary(model_bvar)
```

```{r}
plot(model_bvar)
```


```{r}
set.seed(42)
h <- ceiling(0.2 * nrow(Y))
n_total <- nrow(Y)
n_train <- n_total - h
Y_train <- Y[1:n_train, ]
Y_test  <- Y[(n_train + 1):n_total, ]

cat("Jumlah data train:", nrow(Y_train), "\n")
cat("Jumlah data test :", nrow(Y_test), "\n")
results <- data.frame()
```

set.seed(42)
model <- bvar(Y_train, lags = 1, n_draw = 2000, n_burn = 1500, verbose = TRUE)

```{r}
param_grid <- expand.grid(
  lags   = c(1,2),
  n_draw = c(1500,2000,2500,3000,3500,4000),
  n_burn = c(1000,1500,2000,2500,3000,3500)
)
param_grid <- param_grid[param_grid$n_burn < param_grid$n_draw, ]
```

```{r}
results <- list()
```

```{r}
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)
cl <- makeCluster(4)   
registerDoParallel(cl)
```

#```{r}
results <- foreach(i = 1:nrow(param_grid), .combine = rbind,
                   .packages = c("BVAR")) %dopar% {

  params <- param_grid[i, ]
  set.seed(42)
  
  model <- bvar(
    Y_train,
    lags   = params$lags,
    n_draw = params$n_draw,
    n_burn = params$n_burn,
    verbose = TRUE
  )
  
  # Forecast
  fcast_settings <- bv_fcast(horizon = h)
  fc <- predict(model, fcast_settings)
  
  fc_mean <- fc$quants["50%", , ]
  fc_mean <- fc_mean[1:h, , drop = FALSE]
  
  mae <- function(actual, pred) mean(abs(actual - pred))
  rmse <- function(actual, pred) sqrt(mean((actual - pred)^2))
  
  out <- list()
  for (j in 1:ncol(Y_test)) {
    forecast_vals <- as.numeric(fc_mean[, j])
    names(forecast_vals) <- paste0("Forecast_t", 1:h)
    
    row <- data.frame(
      Variable = colnames(Y_test)[j],
      lag      = params$lags,
      n_draw   = params$n_draw,
      n_burn   = params$n_burn,
      WAIC     = WAIC(model),
      MAE      = mae(Y_test[, j], forecast_vals),
      RMSE     = rmse(Y_test[, j], forecast_vals),
      t(forecast_vals),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    out[[length(out) + 1]] <- row
  }
  
  do.call(rbind, out)
                   }

stopCluster(cl)
registerDoSEQ()
#```

```{r}
results_tuning_waic <- foreach(i = 1:nrow(param_grid), .combine = rbind,.packages = c("BVAR")) %dopar% {
  params <- param_grid[i, ]
  set.seed(42)
  
  # Estimasi Model
  model <- BVAR::bvar(
    Y_train,
    lags = params$lags,
    n_draw = params$n_draw,
    n_burn = params$n_burn,
    hyper = "standard", # Tambahkan ini untuk kestabilan
    verbose = FALSE 
    )
  
  # Hitung WAIC untuk SELURUH SISTEM (Multivariat Measure)
  waic_sistem <- BVAR::WAIC(model)
  
  # Simpan WAIC dan Parameter
  data.frame(
    lag = params$lags,
    n_draw = params$n_draw,
    n_burn = params$n_burn,
    WAIC = waic_sistem,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
}
```



```{r}
results
```

```{r}
## pastikan hasil jadi data.frame dan kolom numeric
results_df <- as.data.frame(results)
num_cols <- setdiff(colnames(results_df), "Variable")
results_df[num_cols] <- lapply(results_df[num_cols], as.numeric)
```

```{r}
## --- pilih model terbaik (RMSE terkecil) ---
library(dplyr)
best_models <- results_df %>%
  mutate(total_error = RMSE + MAE) %>%     # atau (RMSE + MAE) / 2
  group_by(Variable) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = total_error, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()

best_models
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

plot_forecast_vs_actual_saved <- function(Y_train, Y_test, var_name, best_models, horizon) {
  best_row <- best_models[best_models$Variable == var_name, ]
  
  forecast_cols <- grep("^Forecast_t", names(best_row), value = TRUE)
  forecast_vals <- as.numeric(best_row[forecast_cols])
  
  years <- time(Y_train)
  forecast_years <- max(years) + 1:horizon
  
  actual_vals <- c(Y_train[, var_name], Y_test[, var_name])
  forecast_vals <- c(rep(NA, nrow(Y_train)), forecast_vals)
  
  df_plot <- data.frame(
    Year = c(years, forecast_years),
    Actual = actual_vals,
    Forecast = forecast_vals
  )
  
  # Plot
  ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = Year)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Actual, color = "Actual"), size = 1.2) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Forecast, color = "Forecast"), size = 1.2, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = max(years), linetype = "dotted") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Forecast vs Aktual untuk", var_name),
      x = "Tahun",
      y = "Nilai",
      color = ""
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Actual" = "steelblue", "Forecast" = "firebrick"))
}

for (v in unique(best_models$Variable)) {
  print(plot_forecast_vs_actual_saved(Y_train, Y_test, v, best_models, horizon = h))
}
```
